paragraphs.text: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreae:
paragraphs.original: Συνίστημι δὲ ὑμῖν Φοίβην τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν, οὖσαν καὶ διάκονον τῆς ἐκκλησίας τῆς ἐν Κεγχρεαῖς,
paragraphs.translit: Synistēmi de hymin Phoibēn tēn adelphēn hēmōn, ousan kai diakonon tēs ekklēsias tēs en Kenchreais,

paragraphs.text: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.
paragraphs.original: ἵνα αὐτὴν προσδέξησθε ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως τῶν ἁγίων, καὶ παραστῆτε αὐτῇ ἐν ᾧ ἂν ὑμῶν χρῄζῃ πράγματι, καὶ γὰρ αὐτὴ προστάτις πολλῶν ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐμοῦ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hina autēn prosdexēsthe en kyriō axiōs tōn hagiōn, kai parastēte autē en hō an hymōn chrēzē pragmati, kai gar autē prostatis pollōn egenēthē kai emou autou.

paragraphs.text: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάσασθε Πρίσκαν καὶ Ἀκύλαν τοὺς συνεργούς μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Aspasasthe Priskan kai Akylan tous synergous mou en Christō Iēsou,

paragraphs.text: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:
paragraphs.original: οἵτινες ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς μου τὸν ἑαυτῶν τράχηλον ὑπέθηκαν, οἷς οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος εὐχαριστῶ ἀλλὰ καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῶν ἐθνῶν,
paragraphs.translit: hoitines hyper tēs psychēs mou ton heautōn trachēlon hypethēkan, hois ouk egō monos eucharistō alla kai pasai hai ekklēsiai tōn ethnōn,

paragraphs.text: and [salute] the church that is in their house. Salute Epaenetus my beloved, who is the first-fruits of Asia unto Christ.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὴν κατʼ οἶκον αὐτῶν ἐκκλησίαν. ἀσπάσασθε Ἐπαίνετον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου, ὅς ἐστιν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀσίας εἰς Χριστόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai tēn katʼ oikon autōn ekklēsian. aspasasthe Epaineton ton agapēton mou, hos estin aparchē tēs Asias eis Christon.

paragraphs.text: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Μαριάμ, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν εἰς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Mariam, hētis polla ekopiasen eis hymas.

paragraphs.text: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀνδρόνικον καὶ Ἰουνίαν τοὺς συγγενεῖς μου καὶ συναιχμαλώτους μου, οἵτινές εἰσιν ἐπίσημοι ἐν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις, οἳ καὶ πρὸ ἐμοῦ γέγοναν ἐν Χριστῷ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Andronikon kai Iounian tous syngeneis mou kai synaichmalōtous mou, hoitines eisin episēmoi en tois apostolois, hoi kai pro emou gegonan en Christō.

paragraphs.text: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀμπλιᾶτον τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Ampliaton ton agapēton mou en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Οὐρβανὸν τὸν συνεργὸν ἡμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ καὶ Στάχυν τὸν ἀγαπητόν μου.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Ourbanon ton synergon hēmōn en Christō kai Stachyn ton agapēton mou.

paragraphs.text: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the [household] of Aristobulus.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀπελλῆν τὸν δόκιμον ἐν Χριστῷ. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἀριστοβούλου.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Apellēn ton dokimon en Christō. aspasasthe tous ek tōn Aristoboulou.

paragraphs.text: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the [household] of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ἡρῳδίωνα τὸν συγγενῆ μου. ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἐκ τῶν Ναρκίσσου τοὺς ὄντας ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Hērōdiōna ton syngenē mou. aspasasthe tous ek tōn Narkissou tous ontas en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Τρύφαιναν καὶ Τρυφῶσαν τὰς κοπιώσας ἐν κυρίῳ. ἀσπάσασθε Περσίδα τὴν ἀγαπητήν, ἥτις πολλὰ ἐκοπίασεν ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Tryphainan kai Tryphōsan tas kopiōsas en kyriō. aspasasthe Persida tēn agapētēn, hētis polla ekopiasen en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ῥοῦφον τὸν ἐκλεκτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Rhouphon ton eklekton en kyriō kai tēn mētera autou kai emou.

paragraphs.text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Ἀσύγκριτον, Φλέγοντα, Ἑρμῆν, Πατροβᾶν, Ἑρμᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἀδελφούς.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Asynkriton, Phlegonta, Hermēn, Patroban, Herman kai tous syn autois adelphous.

paragraphs.text: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε Φιλόλογον καὶ Ἰουλίαν, Νηρέα καὶ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ, καὶ Ὀλυμπᾶν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς πάντας ἁγίους.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe Philologon kai Ioulian, Nērea kai tēn adelphēn autou, kai Olympan kai tous syn autois pantas hagious.

paragraphs.text: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ. Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς αἱ ἐκκλησίαι πᾶσαι τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati hagiō. Aspazontai hymas hai ekklēsiai pasai tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, σκοπεῖν τοὺς τὰς διχοστασίας καὶ τὰ σκάνδαλα παρὰ τὴν διδαχὴν ἣν ὑμεῖς ἐμάθετε ποιοῦντας, καὶ ἐκκλίνετε ἀπʼ αὐτῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō de hymas, adelphoi, skopein tous tas dichostasias kai ta skandala para tēn didachēn hēn hymeis emathete poiountas, kai ekklinete apʼ autōn·

paragraphs.text: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.
paragraphs.original: οἱ γὰρ τοιοῦτοι τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν Χριστῷ οὐ δουλεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τῇ ἑαυτῶν κοιλίᾳ, καὶ διὰ τῆς χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐλογίας ἐξαπατῶσι τὰς καρδίας τῶν ἀκάκων.
paragraphs.translit: hoi gar toioutoi tō kyriō hēmōn Christō ou douleuousin alla tē heautōn koilia, kai dia tēs chrēstologias kai eulogias exapatōsi tas kardias tōn akakōn.

paragraphs.text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.
paragraphs.original: ἡ γὰρ ὑμῶν ὑπακοὴ εἰς πάντας ἀφίκετο· ἐφʼ ὑμῖν οὖν χαίρω, θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς σοφοὺς εἶναι εἰς τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἀκεραίους δὲ εἰς τὸ κακόν.
paragraphs.translit: hē gar hymōn hypakoē eis pantas aphiketo· ephʼ hymin oun chairō, thelō de hymas sophous einai eis to agathon, akeraious de eis to kakon.

paragraphs.text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης συντρίψει τὸν Σατανᾶν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν ἐν τάχει. ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθʼ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos tēs eirēnēs syntripsei ton Satanan hypo tous podas hymōn en tachei. hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou methʼ hymōn.

paragraphs.text: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
paragraphs.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Τιμόθεος ὁ συνεργός μου, καὶ Λούκιος καὶ Ἰάσων καὶ Σωσίπατρος οἱ συγγενεῖς μου.
paragraphs.translit: Aspazetai hymas Timotheos ho synergos mou, kai Loukios kai Iasōn kai Sōsipatros hoi syngeneis mou.

paragraphs.text: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζομαι ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Τέρτιος ὁ γράψας τὴν ἐπιστολὴν ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: aspazomai hymas egō Tertios ho grapsas tēn epistolēn en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Γάϊος ὁ ξένος μου καὶ ὅλης τῆς ἐκκλησίας. ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Ἔραστος ὁ οἰκονόμος τῆς πόλεως καὶ Κούαρτος ὁ ἀδελφός.
paragraphs.translit: aspazetai hymas Gaios ho xenos mou kai holēs tēs ekklēsias. aspazetai hymas Erastos ho oikonomos tēs poleōs kai Kouartos ho adelphos.

paragraphs.text: [The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.]
paragraphs.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν. Ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: Hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meta pantōn hymōn. Amēn.

paragraphs.text: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,
but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:
to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
